# SOL Systems Explorer

SOL Systems Explorer sells interactive technical-explainer software/templates and custom visualization services.

## Live self-serve products
- SOL Explorer Lite — $29 one-time — simple 2–4 module systems — https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/lite.html
- SOL Systems Explorer Starter Kit — $79 one-time — general-purpose interactive technical explainer — https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/
- SOL Explorer Studio Pack — $199 one-time — reusable client-work package for consultants/studios/agencies — https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/studio.html

## Demonstrated capabilities
- editable JSON system data
- browser-based interactive system visualization
- mobile-friendly navigation
- component/module inspection
- standalone HTML export

## Custom service
- Concept Explorer Pilot — $2,500–$5,000 planning range
- Technical System Explorer — $10,000–$30,000 planning range

## Not claimed
- CAD software
- engineering simulation
- certified digital twin
- safety-critical engineering validation
- automated CAD conversion
- PLM/MBSE or live telemetry unless separately delivered
